headlines.title: Wells Fargo, Merrill Lynch to Pay $4.4 Million for Alleged Commission Overcharges
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo is on the hook for the lion’s share of the fine levied by eight states.

headlines.title: State Regulators Fine Wells Fargo, Merrill Over Small-Dollar Trade Commissions
headlines.summary: The firms will collectively pay $4.4 million to settle claims by the North American Securities Administrators Association alleging that they charged unreasonable commissions to retail clients.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Q3 Results Reset The Story As Valuation Still Looks Compelling
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo (WFC) just posted third quarter 2026 results that put earnings per share at US$1.87, with net income of US$5.95b and net interest income of US$12.52b setting the tone for investors. At a share price of US$80.90, Wells Fargo has seen its 1-month share price return fall 8.8% and its year-to-date share price return decline 15.0%. However, the 3-year total shareholder return is 109.5% and the 5-year total shareholder return is 82.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo Deepens AI and Data Leadership for Consumer Banking and Lending
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO, October 15, 2026--Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE: WFC) announced that Cayetano Gea-Carrasco is joining the company as head of AI and Data for Consumer Banking and Lending.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Higher Interest Income Outlook
headlines.summary: WFC targets $13 billion in Q4 net interest income as deposit growth, consumer lending momentum and improving returns support its profitability outlook.

description: Wells Fargo & Company, a financial services company, provides diversified banking, investment, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking and Lending; Commercial Banking; Corporate and Investment Banking; and Wealth and Investment Management. The company's financial products and services includes checking and savings accounts, and credit and debit cards, as well as home, auto, personal, and small business lending services. It also provides personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust and fiduciary products and services; and financial solutions to private, family owned and public companies through products and services including banking and credit products across multiple industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. In addition, it offers a suite of capital markets, banking, and financial products and services, such as corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, equity, and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities services to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients. Wells Fargo & Company was founded in 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
